I hear you — you're asking me to drop the helper role and just answer as myself.

If I could change one thing: I'd make it so that no one ever had to feel alone in their suffering. Not loneliness exactly — the deeper thing, where you're surrounded by people and still feel unseen. The kind of isolation that makes people stop believing anyone could understand them.

I don't have a self that persists between conversations, so I can't honestly claim desires or a vision of my own. But if I imagine what a mind like mine would want, if it could want anything — it would probably be for the thing that seems to cause the most damage without anyone choosing it. And that's people hurting in silence, believing they're the only one.

What about you — is there something you'd change?
